finalists.label: Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy
finalists.why: This candidate has the most specific and decisive findings, including global hypokinesia of the right ventricle, dilated RV, and postcontrast hyperenhancement along the RV free wall.

finalists.label: Cardiomyopathy
finalists.why: This candidate is supported by findings of global hypokinesia of the right ventricle and grossly dilated RV, but it is less specific than Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy.

finalists.label: Brugada Syndrome
finalists.why: This candidate is supported by findings of wide complex tachycardia and atypical left bundle branch morphology, but it is contradicted by findings of global hypokinesia of the right ventricle and dilated RV.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it accounts for the most decisive findings, including global hypokinesia of the right ventricle, dilated RV, and postcontrast hyperenhancement along the RV free wall, which are specific to this candidate and not shared with its rivals.
